messages.subject_clean: Bayesian Population Analysis Workshop, Patuxent Wildlife Research Center July 8-12 2013
messages.body_plain:
hi all,
This is the 2nd announcement for the workshop listed in the Subject.
See details here:

http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=2366&sid=6e5a9fa91fc3d48e20568427459b42b3

We still have space available. The workshop covers Bayesian analyses using BUGS and JAGS software of a wide variety of models that are useful for population ecologists and managers, e.g., Poisson GLMMs, state-space models, closed population models, Cormack-Jolly-Seber and Jolly-Seber models, multistate models, ring-recovery models,
integrated population models and hierarchical models for distribution and abundance in structured populations (i.e., site-occupancy and N-mixture models).

The workshop is based on the recent book by Kery and Schaub, "Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS", published by Academic Press in 2012, a copy of which will be handed out to each participant.

Please also note the possibility to apply for a Jim Nichols Travel Award; see www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/workshops/ <http://www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/workshops/> for more information.

Kind regards  --

Andy (for Marc and Michael)
